title: 第17章 还是暴露行踪第18章 又一次进化
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
目瞪口呆！
很显然，眼前这个鬼脸，修炼某种鬼道魔功，根本不是李凡能应对的！
在生死关头，小黑狗竟然出来大发神威，只是吐出一个气泡，直接将鬼脸困住。
然后，小黑狗小嘴一吸，气泡开始以肉眼可见的速度变小，最终，被小黑狗一口吞下。
嗡！
小黑狗的身体，发出一道奇异的粉红色灵光。
然后，小黑狗拟人化的一伸懒腰，再次呼呼大睡起来。
“这？”
李凡是目瞪口呆。
毫不起眼的癞皮狗，竟然能秒杀这个实力彪悍的鬼脸。
“难道是鬼修？”
李凡喃喃自语。
实在是李凡以前一直生存在修仙界的最底层，对修仙界的一些诡异门道，知之甚少。
不过，有一点，李凡可以肯定，这个小黑狗绝对不简单。
现在不是追究这一切的时候，李凡开始整理这次的收获，以及打扫战场。
先是把枯骨身上的储物戒指收起来，然后再把韩冬四人的储物袋同样据为己有。
并且，李凡再次回到先前的三个房间，逐一仔细检查，只是在炼丹室里，发现足足五百二十七瓶废丹。
众所周知，废丹是炼制出现问题，含有杂质的丹药。
废丹，不仅没有作用，反而有害，基本上等同于垃圾废品。
可是，本着绝不浪费的原则，李凡还是全部把这些废丹收进储物戒指里。

然后是打扫战场，将韩冬四人的尸体，包括灵兽螳螂，用火球术毁尸灭迹，并且将一切可能暴露五人身份的信息，全部抹除掉，不留一点痕迹。
而志南和尚的那个傀儡，李凡暂时收起来，或许还有什么用处。
收拾好一切，确定没有任何遗漏，李凡这才退出筑基期前辈的府邸，沿着走廊，回到岩石出口。
谨慎起见，李凡没有冒失的直接出去，而是先戴上面具，幻化成一个红脸大汉，再先将小黑狗扔出去。
啪嗒！
小黑狗扔出去后，没有一点异常。
等待一个时辰，确定没有危险，李凡这才从出口小心翼翼的冲出来。
沉思片刻，在岩石出口这里灭杀的可是一个修仙家族的成员，事情绝对不会这么简单的结束。
李凡最终选择向回江安城相反的方向飞奔而去。
飞出后不久，李凡果然发现两个身穿家族服装的修士，不过修为只有炼气二层。
这次，李凡没有立刻逃走，而是大摇大摆的出现在两个家伙面前。
“你是什么人？”
两个修士十分警惕，手中已经拿出几张符咒。
“妈了个巴子的！”
李凡现在幻化的形象，可是红脸大汉，立刻一个诡异的身法，如同瞬移一般，来到两个修士身前。
不由分说，李凡抡起巴掌，一通猛扇。
这两个家伙，好歹也是炼气二层的修士，在李凡神奇的身法面前，却毫无招架之力。
啪，啪！
一通响亮的大嘴巴子，扇的二人晕头转向。
content_en:
stunned!
Obviously, the grimace in front of him, practicing some kind of ghost magic skill, is not something Li Fan can handle at all!
At the critical moment of life and death, the little black dog came out to show off his power, and just spit out a bubble, directly trapping the ghost face.
Then, the little black dog sucked in the small mouth, and the bubbles began to get smaller at a speed visible to the naked eye. Finally, the little black dog swallowed it in one gulp.
Buzz!
The body of the little black dog emits a strange pink aura.
Then, the little black dog stretched out in an anthropomorphic way and fell asleep again.
"This?"
Li Fan was stunned.
The inconspicuous mangy dog ​​was actually able to kill this powerful Ghostface instantly.
"Is it a ghost cultivator?"
Li Fan murmured to himself.
In fact, Li Fan has always lived at the bottom of the world of immortality, and he knows very little about some weird ways in the world of immortality.
However, one thing is certain, Li Fan is sure that this little black dog is definitely not simple.
Now is not the time to pursue all this. Li Fan began to sort out the harvest and clean up the battlefield.
First, he put away the storage ring on Dry Bones, and then took the storage bags of Han Dong and the others as his own.
Moreover, Li Fan returned to the previous three rooms again and carefully inspected each one, only to find a total of 527 bottles of waste elixirs in the alchemy room.
As we all know, waste elixirs are elixirs that have problems refining and contain impurities.
Waste elixirs not only have no effect, but are harmful. They are basically equivalent to garbage.
However, in line with the principle of never wasting, Li Fan still collected all these waste pills into the storage ring.
Then the battlefield was cleaned, and the bodies of Han Dong and the four of them, including the spiritual beast Mantis, were destroyed using fireball techniques, and all information that might reveal the identities of the five people was wiped out without leaving any trace.
As for Monk Zhinan's puppet, Li Fan put it away for the time being. It might have some use.
After packing everything up and making sure that nothing was missing, Li Fan exited the foundation-building senior's mansion and walked along the corridor back to the rock exit.
To be cautious, Li Fan did not go out rashly. Instead, he put on a mask and transformed into a red-faced man, and then threw the little black dog out first.
Snap!
After the little black dog was thrown out, there was nothing abnormal.
After waiting for an hour and confirming that there was no danger, Li Fan cautiously rushed out from the exit.
After pondering for a moment, the person killed at the rock exit was a member of a cultivating immortal family. The matter would never end so simply.
Li Fan finally chose to fly in the opposite direction back to Jiang'an City.
Not long after flying out, Li Fan found two monks wearing family clothes, but their cultivation was only at the second level of Qi Refining.
This time, Li Fan did not run away immediately, but appeared in front of the two guys in a swaggering manner.
"Who are you?"
The two monks were very vigilant and had already taken out several talismans in their hands.
"What a bastard!"
Li Fan's current transformed image was that of a red-faced man. He immediately used a strange movement technique, as if teleporting, and came to the two monks.
Without any explanation, Li Fan raised his hand and slapped him fiercely.
These two guys, after all, were monks on the second level of Qi Refining, but they were helpless in the face of Li Fan's miraculous movement skills.
Bang, bang!
A loud slap made the two of them dizzy.
